newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber down further on liquidation, weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber down further on liquidation, weak cash.

text.p: Further long liquidation ahead of its expiration at 12:05 CDT pushed May CME lumber futures down with other months also under pressure from the weak cash market, traders said.
"There's no demand in the cash to help support (May) so we are just going further into liquidation with no real bids to take delivery," said Curt Cunningham, President of Pacific Futures Trading.
Traders noted that there is too much product available for the limited demand and cash lumber prices will likely continue to erode.
Trading activity may be uneven at times ahead of Friday's U.S. housing starts report, they added.
At 0936 CDT, lumber stood $5.80 to $0.60 per tbf lower with limitless May off most at $382.50 and July off $1.60 at $391.70 per tbf.
